text: Cute floating island with a bunny thing and a tomato patch. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. It says tap the ripe crop - the tomatoes look red, tapping them.

Harvested once (+4 coins), sowed and watered, crop regrew fast. Now the Momo panel opened; tutorial says tap pencil to pick tiles it looks after. The tooltip covers the panel text a bit. Tapping pencil.
Momo now farms the plot by itself, coins ticking up (+12/min). Mail bubble above the Momo and a red dot on Mailbox. I'm still in tile-pick mode 1/4; confirming with the check.
Sweet letter from Momo proposing Field expansion research. Love the stationery look. Tapping Let's research it.

Research tree is big (Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games...). Field expansion needs 3 flasks + 20 coins, and a research lab. So I need to build a lab on an empty tile. Closing and tapping the empty grass on the left.

Level 2 now. Built a second farm; Momo walked over and started sowing it on its own. Accepted a second research proposal (watering efficiency). Now trying to put a research lab on the empty front-right grass.
Experiment made 1 flask (1/3). Each experiment is a manual 3-sec tap. Doing two more. Got another letter too.
Momo walked into the lab by itself and is running experiments (lab 1/1). 2/3 flasks. Waiting with the research panel open for the third flask.
Level 3 - Mine unlocked. Started Field expansion research (30s, cost 3 flasks + 20). Flasks seem to be one shared pool. Now looking at the last empty front tile.
Mine costs 120 coins plus 10 wood, so I need wood first. Building a Lumberyard (80) on the last tile.
Bought the sea plot for 25; island grew a new grassy corner. Lumberyard is up. Income dipped a bit (60 -> 56/min), maybe one Momo is spread too thin. Tapping the Momo to see what it is doing.
Confused by the Lumberyard: I tapped Fell (4 sec), waited, the tree is still there and now it says Fell 7s left. Did I get wood? Checking Status for an inventory.
Store tab answers it: Wood 6/50, Research notes 4/30, crops auto-sold at 4 each. So felling works, the tree just regrows. Need 10 wood + 120 coins for a Mine. Research has a red dot - checking.
Halfway. Field expansion Lv1 done, Lv2 researching (45s). Income now ~108/min. The City goal needs 3 Momos - wondering how to get more. Peeking at the Shop.
Hired a second Momo, Mochi, for 50. Going to give Mochi the lab and lumberyard so the first Momo can stick to the farms.
6 min in. Two Momos busy; one has a ... speech bubble at the lab. 173 coins. Trying to build the Mine on the new corner tile.
Mine is going up (cost 120 + 10 wood). Research panel shows more tabs now (Cars, Ger..?). Only 4 notes, nothing affordable yet - red dot on Research was a bit misleading. Checking mail.
Mine is running, income jumped to ~194/min. Accepted a Tree nursery proposal. Going for the City goals: hire a third Momo and buy the 35-coin sea plot.
Three Momos now, each on their own spot (farms, lab, mine). Income ~200/min. Buying the 35-coin plot next.
Special = landmarks (Clock Tower Lv5, School Lv4, Momo Monument Lv6), all locked for now. Going back and putting a cheap Farm on the new plot.
Started Bigger harvests (2 min). Hit Level 4 - School should be open now. Checking City progress in Status.
City needs Land 9 (have 6), research levels 3 (have 2), value 1.5K (970). Momo 3/3 done. Buying the next dashed sea plot at the bottom right.
School needs 400 + 30 wood + 20 stone - can't afford the materials yet. Backing out and placing another farm on this plot.
Building a second Lumberyard toward the School's wood cost. Income about 300/min, up from 4/min at the start. Reading the latest Momo letter with the last seconds.
Pomu (the miner I hired) wrote its own letter about copper in the rock - nice that each Momo seems to have a voice tied to its job. Accepted Copper prospecting. Wrapping up.
